To,
All Addl. CPFC (Zones) including ACC (HQ),
All Regional PF Commissioners,
In-charge of the Region,
Director (PDNASS)

Subject: Implementation of the Transfer Policy for the cadre of Social Security
Assistant (TP SSA) -reg

Ma’am/Sir,

Please refer to the Transfer Policy for the cadre of Social Security Assistant, 2022
circulated on 12.12.2022 (Web Circular No. 270 of 2022-23).

In this regard, it is to inform that the same has been challenged by employees in
various benches of Hon’ble CAT including Principal Bench & stay against the
implementation of the policy has been granted in various cases. In compliance of the same,
action for initiating the process of calling online options as per policy could not be initiated
by this office.

In view of the above, all are advised to scrupulously comply with the stay orders.
Transfer orders, issued if any, may be withdrawn with immediate effect under intimation to
this office.

{This has the approval of CPFC}
Yours faithfully,

ee
(R K Singh)
ACC (HQ) HR
